title: Tie the docs enum lists and the kind enums to the schema
lead: Nothing ties the enum lists in docs/descriptor.md (families touchstone, keyValue and stdf are listed without a planned mark; the kind example shows labSweepTable/K05) to the schema enums, and schema test 6 does not compare the `kind` label and rule id enums with `Profiler`'s `InterimKind` constants. sq-15 is the natural place for the kind half. Compare both with tests, marking planned values.
